lavender.description: Sacred Lavender — primary brand color. Active states, labels, focus rings.

lavender-deep.description: Deep Lavender — hover/pressed variant of primary.

lavender-tint.description: Lavender Tint — Vata dosha semantic tint. Badge backgrounds.

peach.description: Deeper Peach — logo accent, brand warmth.

peach-tint.description: Peach Tint — Pitta dosha semantic tint.

mint-tint.description: Mint Tint — Kapha dosha semantic tint.

blue-tint.description: Blue Tint — fourth dosha tint. Vata-air contexts.

slate-muted.description: Muted Slate — tertiary, subtle UI elements.

ink.description: Ink — primary text, submit button background.

error.description: Error — rose toast icon, delete hover.

lift-subtle.description: Default lift under Soma input capsule and primary coaching cards.

lift-lavender.description: Hover state on Soma input — lavender-tinted bloom signalling readiness.

ease-standard.description: Default state transitions — color, background, border.

ease-breath.description: Breathing lotus and ambient pulsing — slow, body-aware rhythms.

duration-std.description: Standard state changes: hover color, background shift.

duration-slow.description: Page transitions, modal entry, view switches.

sm.description: Welcome screen stacks to single column; header collapses.

md.description: Coaching dashboard switches from single to two-column layout.

lg.description: Max content width kicks in; side panels become visible.

display.description: Hero greeting, page-level statements. One per screen. Always sentence case. Italic variant preferred.

heading.description: Card titles, coaching category headers, modal titles.

body-serif.description: AI coaching text, philosophical copy, in-practice guidance. Always italic. Max 65ch.

body.description: UI descriptions, input placeholder, secondary information. Max 70ch.

label.description: Badge text, tab labels, section markers, chip text. Always uppercase.

micro.description: Footer, sub-badges, eyebrows, status chips. Maximum one use per screen. Always uppercase.

timer.description: Breathwork countdown displays only. This register exists nowhere else in the system.

pill.description: Fully rounded — buttons, chips, input capsule.

card.description: Glass cards, toasts, tab switcher container.

tab.description: Individual tab buttons inside the switcher.

default.description: All borders in the system are 1px. The sole exception is the focus ring at 2px.

radial-peach.description: Peach tint radial glow fading to transparent. Warm, Pitta-associated.

radial-lavender.description: Lavender tint radial glow fading to transparent. Primary brand tint.

radial-blue.description: Blue tint radial glow fading to transparent. Vata-air associated.

radial-mint.description: Mint tint radial glow fading to transparent. Kapha/earth associated.

linear-peach-lavender.description: Diagonal blend from white through peach into lavender. Warm-to-cool tonal arc.

linear-lavender-blue.description: Diagonal blend from lavender tint to blue tint. Cool ethereal pairing.

linear-lavender-mint.description: Soft diagonal blend from lavender tint to mint tint at low opacity. Subtle surface tint.

linear-peach-fade.value: linear-gradient(to bottom right, rgba(251,237,233,0.75), rgba(251,237,233,0.4), rgba(255,255,255,0.2))
linear-peach-fade.description: Peach tint fading into white. Warm card surface.

linear-stone-fade.description: Neutral stone-50 to stone-100 fade. Subtle background for list containers.
